Background: a sunny city plaza of light paving with a low fountain edge, a street lamp and standard-height shop doors behind her, strong rim backlight, silhouette definition, halo effect, bohemian free-spirited mood, natural earthy atmosphere, artistic editorial, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so her extreme height reads at a glance, the towering soles clearly in view. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
